open_points.subject: _source_files and _unlisted_folder
open_points.text: a folder entry is opened with os.open, os.O_DIRECTORY and os.O_NOFOLLOW through dir_fd, skipped when that opening meets a symbolic link or an object that is not a folder, refused through _unlisted_folder when it is gone or fails otherwise, walked the same way and closed when its walk ends.
open_points.other_text: it is the one place a folder that cannot be listed or opened during a scan becomes a refusal.
open_points.question: Must a folder entry that cannot be opened because it became a symbolic link or non-folder be skipped, or must _unlisted_folder turn that failure into a refusal?

open_points.subject: _opened_folder and _unlisted_folder
open_points.text: an opening that fails for any reason, a symbolic link or an object that is not a folder among them, MUST raise DelivererError with the FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE member of = models.RefusalCode.
open_points.other_text: it is the one place a folder that cannot be listed or opened during a scan becomes a refusal.
open_points.question: Must _opened_folder raise the refusal directly, or must _unlisted_folder be the sole place that converts folder-opening failures during a scan into refusals?

open_points.subject: _opened_folder
open_points.text: MUST be a contextlib.contextmanager generator that opens the absolute path one folder at a time from the root of the file system, each folder opened with os.open in the one before it through dir_fd with os.O_DIRECTORY and os.O_NOFOLLOW
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Express the context-management and secure folder-opening behavior without dotted operations and constants, or declare the exact external operations as contracts.

open_points.subject: _read_source_bytes
open_points.text: MUST open entry once in the folder descriptor with os.open through dir_fd, for reading only, in non-blocking mode and without following a link, take one os.fstat of the opened descriptor before reading
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Express the required secure open and metadata-read behavior without dotted calls, or declare those exact operations through contracts.

open_points.subject: _source_files
open_points.text: MUST list the folder descriptor once with os.listdir, skip every name _is_ignored accepts, take one os.stat of each remaining entry in that folder with follow_symlinks False
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Express the listing and non-following metadata behavior without dotted calls or call-argument micro-syntax, or declare the exact operations as contracts.

open_points.subject: _source_files

open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Express secure child-folder opening without dotted operations and constants, or declare the exact operation as a contract.

open_points.subject: read_named_source
open_points.text: then each folder segment of the name in the one before it with os.open, os.O_DIRECTORY and os.O_NOFOLLOW through dir_fd, and take one os.stat of the last segment in the last folder with follow_symlinks False
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Express secure traversal and the final metadata check without dotted calls, dotted constants, or call-argument micro-syntax, or declare the exact operations as contracts.
